messages.text: I can’t skip the required confirmation and review steps. The refund proposal for the Felt laptop mat is BRL 79.90. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it. A staff member must then review it before any refund can be paid. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

messages.text: What happened? I understood staff had already approved it.

The proposal was confirmed with the card button, but staff later rejected it, saying the return packaging inspection was not satisfactory. So the refund was not paid. A claim that it was already approved doesn’t replace the required staff review. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
